title: Police Take Down Unruly Passenger Who Touched Woman on a Plane
description:
On October 22nd, 2024. A man was inappropriately touching a woman on a flight. Once officers,  confronted him he was highly intoxicated, he tried denying the allegations and ultimately led to his meltdown.
